title: Forwarder comparisons omit the Remote Upgrader management boundary
problem: The comparison provides UF version steps, OS/package information and receiver checks. It does not explain the separate host-installed Remote Upgrader or the customer-managed deployment server that can distribute packages in a Cloud-facing deployment.

versions: 10.6 guides; documented source and signed-package floors
deployments: Customer-managed Linux and Windows; Cloud-facing deployments
exclusions: No particular OS/version path, customer entitlement, Cloud-native deployment-server capability or regulated authorization is inferred.

impact.customerScenario: Planning centralized UF package upgrades for Linux or Windows hosts that report to Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud Platform.
impact.consequence: Operators can mistake a Cloud receiver support result or deployment-server content distribution for evidence that a specific package upgrade can be automated.

confidence.rationale: Compared the existing VersionCompass UF report model with exact official Agent Management, Remote Upgrader and Cloud service sections.

lifecycle.reason: The repository guide has an initial scope note. Exact route-specific automation guidance is not yet part of the comparison.

coverageSearch.question: Which customer-managed component installs signed UF packages and what limits the supported Linux and Windows paths?
coverageSearch.expectedAnswer: Separate deployment-server distribution from installation by the host upgrader, then show the selected OS/package and UF upgrade-path qualifications.
coverageSearch.limits: Reviewed the existing report, Enterprise 10.6 Agent Management, the versioned Remote Upgrader guides and current Cloud management descriptions. No tenant-specific management support was evaluated.
